name: Sergio Restrepo
headline: Chief Experience Office, Chief Customer Officer
bio:
With a strong background in multi-country and multicultural marketing, I have built a solid foundation for driving development strategies and integrating creative digital solutions to achieve business growth. Whether managing existing accounts or expanding into new market territories, I understand the challenges and importance of collaboration required to execute successful growth marketing initiatives. My current focus is on developing integrated customer data platforms to achieve successful omnichannel marketing capabilities.

I am also an invited professor in digital marketing and digital transformation at top business schools such as ESADE Business School in Spain, Georgetown University and Boston University in the United States, and INCAE Business School in Costa Rica.

Some of my key accomplishments include:

- Creating the POINTS methodology for strategic Go-to-Market efforts.
- Successfully designing and implementing CDP/CRM rollouts using a wide range of tools, including Salesforce, Hubspot, Oracle, and Salesmanago.
-Spearheading the creation of multicultural marketing innovation opportunities for global brands such as Microsoft, Nestlé, 3M, Starbucks, Chrysler, Porsche, Apple, and Google at Lionbridge.
- Founding diverse startups that were later acquired by global and local organizations.
- Attaining the "Great Place to Work" award for two consecutive years and recognition in Forbes as one of the "Top 30 Talent Development Companies" by focusing on technical capabilities and culture at Lionbridge's Costa Rica site.
- Launching full-service digital agencies from concept to creation and growing them to over 200 employees. I positioned these organizations as digital powerhouses, designing and executing innovative Digital Marketing Performance strategies.

headline: Architecting precision-led, full-stack marketing systems for visionary Leaders || 40+ global brands scaled with Clarity and Control || Built a 7-figure agency in 12 months using our Proprietary “A.C.E. Framework”
bio:
Most agencies sell marketing.
We sell "Precision."

At Maverick Digitals, we engineer full-stack digital growth systems that multiply clarity, conversion, and control across every touchpoint your audience experiences. 

We scaled 40+ brands across India, UAE, USA, UK, and beyond — generating $10M+ in measurable growth. 

And within 12 months, we built a 7-figure agency and grew a 23,000+ personal brand — without paid ads, without a huge team, without noise.

To prove our Proprietary A.C.E framework, we applied it to ourselves first:

1] 0 → 23K followers in 6 months
2] Inbound pipeline that stays full
3] High-ticket clients acquired profitably
4] Strategy that performs under pressure

Because when done right:
Branding drives desire. Ads capture demand.

⚙️ The A.C.E. Growth Framework
Attention. Conversion. Execution.

A — Attention that creates authority
• Personal Branding for Founders &CXOs

C — Conversion that compounds profit

• Funnels engineered to close more profitably

E — Execution that scales with control

Each pillar strengthens the next — so scaling becomes predictable, not experimental.

We partner with founders, CMOs, and CEOs leading at the top —
builders obsessed with influence, leverage, and category control.

Because at this level…
Growth is not vanity.

We don’t chase trends.

Clarity creates speed.
